newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian stocks edge higher at open.
newsitem.headline: Australian stocks edge higher at open.

text.p: The Australian share market edged tentatively higher at the open on Monday with modest gains in the major miners overcoming losses in the Commonwealth Bank of Australia after it went ex-dividend 45 cents.
The All Ordinaries index added 6.2 points to 2,488.8.
Brokers said the market had failed to surprise at the start, with only light interest as traders awaited more results with retailer Woolworths the major corporate to report today.

"It's been a middling start. CommBank going ex-dividend has accounted for most of the trade," said a Sydney-based dealer, adding that interest was going to be patchy, if not light, as individual corporates reported.
"Woolies is the big one today but there are still a lot to come," he said.
Commonwealth Bank shares were 49 cents lower at A$13.41 (US$10.25) on active turnover of 8.71 million shares.
Soft drink maker Coca-Cola Amatil Ltd shares slid 31.7 cents to A$13.34 after the company's soft year net profit of A$142.1 million, reported after the market closed on Friday.
Rises outnumbered falls by a ratio of about nine to five, while about 42 percent of stocks traded remained steady.
